The '''kand''' was a type of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] with nutritious [[Diet/Legends|edible]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] that was found on [[Dorin/Legends|Dorin]],<ref name="GCG" /> a dark and dusty [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], plateaus, and valleys located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region's]] [[Deadalis sector/Legends|Deadalis sector]]. Dorin had a highly stormy [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] composed of [[Helium/Legends|helium]] and another, [[Dorin gas/Legends|unique gas]]. Members of the planet's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Species/Legends|species]]<ref name="FDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> eventually adopted the tree's name as a family name.<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The kand was mentioned in [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]]'s [[2003]] [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="GCG" />
